title: Group permissions
purpose: Maintain the capabilities granted to a group of users.
summary: Choose which permissions a group grants its members.

tasks.title: Change a group's permissions
steps: Move permissions between Available permissions and Chosen permissions under [[Permissions]].

tasks.title: Let a group's members release reports
steps: Choose the accounts authorize_release permission and save.

good_to_know: Members are added on each user's account, not on this form.
Built-in group names are read only.
Changes are recorded in the audit history. A later save by someone else replaces yours.

sections.title: Access and fields
paragraphs: The administration site requires an active account with Staff status. User and group pages additionally require Superuser status; a laboratory admin role alone or individual model permissions do not open them. These technical flags do not themselves confer operational roles or report-release authority.

items.label: Name
items.description: Required unique name, at most 150 characters. On existing built-in laboratory groups the name is read only; other existing group names remain editable.

items.label: Permissions
items.description: Optional Available permissions and Chosen permissions with filtering, choose/remove and Choose all/Remove all. accounts authorize_release grants release capability to active internal members. Permissions do not create laboratory roles for arbitrary group names.

sections.title: Membership and history
paragraphs: No user/member selector is on this group form; edit membership on each User. Saves record before/after group snapshots in attributed audit events. There is no original-version token on this form, so a later valid save can replace concurrent edits. Delete is disabled.

items.label: Save
items.description: Validates and saves, then returns to the model list with preserved filters, except the user-creation flow described separately.

items.label: Save and continue editing
items.description: Saves and reopens this record’s change form.

items.label: Save and add another
items.description: Appears only when creation is permitted; saves and opens a fresh add form.

items.label: History
items.description: Existing records only: opens Django administration history, separate from attributed domain audit records.

items.label: Home / app / model breadcrumbs
items.description: Return to administration home, the application module or the current model list.

items.label: View site
items.description: Header link to the operational application. Log out submits immediate sign-out; it has no administration confirmation page.
